payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and results related to recovering from noisy entity linking in query generation.

claims.text: The SubQG approach helps recover from noisy entity/relation linking results by ranking existing query structures or building new ones, achieving promising performance even with limited training data.
In a simulated environment with noisy entity linking, correct answers were still generated in 85% of cases within the top-5 outputs despite a decline in precision.
